title: Duplication clusters: 6 skill-lifecycle meta-skills (skill-developer/skill-development/skill-forge/skill-upgrader/vet-skill/find-skills) and 6 testing skills (test/full-test-suite/qa-test/qa-suite/tdd/tdd-migrate); full-test-suite frontmatter name mismatches its directory

evidence.quote:
name: skill-developer
description: Meta-skill for creating and managing Claude Code skills

name: skill-development
description: Skill Development Rules

name: full-test
description: Complete platform testing suite - functional + frontend design quality testing with graded report

observe_how: Six meta-skills all claim part of the skill-creation lifecycle: skill-developer ('creating and managing'), skill-development ('Skill Development Rules', user-invocable:false), skill-forge (377KB; 'full lifecycle from authoring through validation, testing, optimization, and packaging' — a superset of the other two), skill-upgrader ('Upgrade any skill to v5 Hybrid format', 1 doc ref), vet-skill (external-install vetting, registered), find-skills (discovery, registered). _archived/ even contains archived copies of skill-developer and skill-development while live copies persist — a previous consolidation attempt that didn't finish. Testing cluster: test, full-test-suite (frontmatter says name: full-test, mismatching its full-test-suite directory — whichever identity a router keys on, the other dangles), qa-test, qa-suite, tdd, tdd-migrate (dead, see D7b-04) — overlapping orchestration prose for the same verification job. Consolidation target: skill-forge absorbs skill-developer + skill-upgrader (keep vet-skill and find-skills for their distinct jobs); testing collapses to test + qa-suite (structured) + tdd (philosophy), with full-test-suite either renamed consistently or folded into qa-suite.
telemetry: Per-skill Skill-tool invocation share within each cluster over 30 days — invocation-share <5% for a cluster member supports folding it.

title: Stray ebr-data-prep.skill — a 16KB ZIP archive committed as a flat file in .claude/skills/, never unpacked, not loadable as a skill
observe_how: The file starts with PK zip magic and its central directory lists ebr-data-prep-clean/SKILL.md and ebr-data-prep-clean/scripts/prep_ebr_package.py (16,079 bytes, committed 2026-03-16, b5bffe4). Skills must be <name>/SKILL.md directories — a flat .skill zip is invisible to both the native loader and skill-rules routing, so it is pure junk in the tree and in every sync. Payoff: one `git rm` removes a dead binary from the skill tree and the repo->active sync (or unpack it properly if EBR data prep is still wanted).

title: iq360-event-audit description defers single-query asks to sibling skill `iq360-events` which does not exist in the repo or active ~/.claude/skills

evidence.quote: Differs from `iq360-events`: that skill answers single ad-hoc KQL questions; this skill is for multi-step analyses that end in a report.

observe_how: Grep for 'iq360-events' across .claude/skills finds only iq360-event-audit's own SKILL.md and its evals/trigger_eval.json; `ls .claude/skills | grep iq360` and `ls ~/.claude/skills | grep iq360` both return only iq360-event-audit. The description explicitly instructs the model to 'defer to iq360-events' for single counts/one-liner queries — routing to a skill that doesn't exist, so simple iQ360 queries dead-end or fall back unguided. Payoff: one-line description edit (point at the kusto-cli skill, or restore/create iq360-events) stops the misrouting.
